notes.title: 🛎️We're announcing a new game!🛎️
notes.content:
✨ Welcome back, Fantasy Gamers! ✨

We’ve been dying to show you what we’ve been working on… And the time has finally come. Get ready for a journey full of secrets and fulfilled fantasies...🔥

Hotel Lust

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458754/66ff5577ee1307db04e1c64e5a99126b8039073f.png

Here’s a small taste of what’s to come…

Your boring life as a hotel receptionist takes an unexpected turn when the oldest employee reveals a dark and tempting secret: a network of hidden peepholes connecting all the rooms in the building. What starts as mischief turns into an obsession... Every guest brings their own desires, secrets, and fantasies. You decide whether you only watch… or take part.



And that’s not all! The hotel rooms hide more than you can imagine… 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458754/903c11fac1bc87c7fea25263071f7ebe7beb26ba.png

Meet our irresistible guests: 

💋 Mya Landon – The rebellious wife in search of passion.

🎭 Henny Ritcher – A devoted cosplayer who seduces through character.

😈 Lilith – Spoiled, provocative… and dangerous.

🔞 Irina Petrov – A shameless Russian exhibitionist with zero filters.

😳 Soyeon Lee – A shy girl looking to blow off steam.

💘 Lana Valentine – A full-blown sex goddess who’s tried it ALL… and wants more.

Did one of the girls catch your eye? 🔥

Then add the game to your Steam Wishlist to be the first to know when she checks in 👀.

You’ll be the first to know when we open the doors. 🔑



And of course, you can join our official Discord or follow us on Twitter/X to discuss theories, favorite scenes, or just say hi. We always reply! 😘

With love,

The Fantasy Games Team.

notes.title: New Year... New Game! Ever Hotter: Multi-story and Scorching Secrets!
notes.content:
Happy New Year, Fantasy Gamers! 🥳

In our first post of the year, we want to share two big announcements.

As you know, our goal is to create games that are increasingly complete and original, exploring new and creative paths in adult game genres.

Our Next Project

On that note, our first big news is that we’ve published the store page for Ever Hotter!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/701c35e968d7c2d09d9df83fcd7eb61588af13d5.png

Not only is it the longest AVN we’ve worked on, but it also features a more complex (and fun!) script, packed with choices that will shape your gameplay experience.

Last but not least, it’s a VERY spicy story: the writer had to deal with his “two heads” to finish writing it. 😉

If it caught your attention, add it to your wishlist so Steam will notify you on launch day, and you can take advantage of the release discount!

What Happened with SpyLens?

Some of you might have wondered about the release of SpyLens, our first AVN to feature game mechanics that complement the narrative gameplay.

In short: we couldn’t get it validated in time to launch before the busy holiday period. December is a hectic month, and many people aim to publish at specific dates, which affected the validation process.

The good news is that it’s launching next week!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/c75d786efbaeb6f206e8879d1984fcac9cf2e2c9.png

SpyLens will be released on January 16. We’d love to hear your review if you enjoy it, and your feedback on our Discord channel.

Building on the success of the bundle we created for the launch of Axxx, we’re creating a special new bundle so you can purchase SpyLens with an additional discount on top of the launch discount.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/e10b78f7852620589d4e9b5cb3a8eecbb55cb51b.png

Follow us on our Steam page, Fantasy Games, so we can keep making bigger and better projects!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/830a0462b7630597d903f0f145848f33e33878e2.png

Thank you, as always, for your support. It inspires and motivates us to keep developing new projects. 💟

Hugs,
The Fantasy Games Team

notes.title: Our Next Game! Axxx - Taught and fucked
notes.content:
Hello Fantasy Gamers!

We’re very excited to write our first post to all of you. First of all, thank you so much for supporting us by purchasing Hentai Girls Gallery, our first project.

Your support has motivated us to continue developing new projects 💟 but before we talk about that, we’d like to briefly introduce ourselves.

Fantasy Games

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/648dfe453aeb8348289debab7541c87d2a21a61d.png

We’re a small H-game studio of 2 members, with previous experience in the video game industry.

Our goal is to keep developing H-games, moving on to more ambitious projects step by step, with determination.

We want to expand the H-game universe with unseen elements and more creative approaches, and we would love to have your support to help us grow and make it possible.

Our Next Step

That is, our next project: Axxx - Taught and fucked

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/d97770906277ae8845f337f6c8e3d95af252f8b6.png

We believe this is a special proposal, as it’s an AVN (Adult Visual Novel), but it’s not based on Renpy; it’s built using our own system.

What does this give us? The ability to add any feature we can imagine! As well as improving existing ones, going beyond the typical features of a Renpy-made game.

Additionally, as we create more AVNs in the future, we’ll take advantage of these developments to expand features and retroactively add them to the rest of our AVNs.

By the way, our Fantasy Games Steam page is live! If you’re not following us yet, now is the perfect time. We’re just getting started.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/830a0462b7630597d903f0f145848f33e33878e2.png

And Finally, a Gift

As a token of our appreciation for your support, we’re creating a special bundle so you can get Axxx - Taught and fucked at a special launch discount.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/d6d69fa5e0e68b9093402570bd91f20bacaa09f1.png

Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist so Steam will notify you on launch day, and you can take advantage of the offer!

Best regards,
The Fantasy Games Team
